hints: Check the motor's average voltage reading. Is it the full 6 V?

The duty cycle is the share of time the power is on. At 50%, the power is on half the time, so the average is 3 V. A motor's speed roughly follows that average. It's like flicking a tap on and off very fast: you get about half the water.
Set the duty cycle to 20% and compare the speed with what you get at 100%.
